species_label: Sapin, épinettes, pin gris et mélèzes (SEPM)
accounting_caveats: T2 purchase is a buyer-side procurement cost, not observed log-sale revenue, stumpage, or forest net value. T20 BGAD excludes species gain/loss (reported separately in T22); for SEPM the exclusion is larger than the after-transfer spread. PRCCM road rebates sit inside transfers, so T5 road after PRCCM must not be combined with T10/T20 transfers. Purchase and BGAD are different respondent samples; their difference is a procurement-channel cost spread, not net value.
notes: Cost spread = purchase procurement cost - BGAD procurement cost; it is a channel cost spread, not a mill margin and not forest net value.; Species total; not additive with product rows because volumes are not published.
